sources.title: Jellybook — Frontier.sh
sources.snippet: Jellybook is an iOS app for Jellycat collectors to catalogue, track, and share their collection. I built it for my partner and we run it together — our first iOS app, now live in the App Store.

sources.snippet: Best-in-class comic book reader plugin for Jellyfin. Three display modes, manga RTL, two-page spread with wide-page auto-detect, continuous scroll, progress sync, folder cover mosaics. - jellybook/README.md at main · mrlovelies/jellybook

sources.title: jellybook · GitHub
sources.snippet: Jellybook is a lightweight, open-source development tool that keeps a project's working memory inside the repository itself.

sources.title: Modly — Free Local AI 3D Model Generator | Open Source, Offline
sources.snippet: Turn any photo or text prompt into a 3D model with local AI. Export as GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY. Free, open source, runs entirely on your GPU — no cloud, no account.

sources.title: JellyBuild — The AI Roblox Game Maker
sources.snippet: JellyBuild is an AI Roblox game maker that helps creators build Roblox Studio scripts, UI, game systems, tools, maps, and Builder assets faster with a connected Studio plugin.
